justification: `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/build/Plugin.java` defines `Source` from lines 2256-3429 as a 1,100+ line nested hierarchy with many separate responsibilities: `Origin`, `Element`, `Empty`, `Compound`, `InMemory`, `ForFolder`, `ForJarFile`, `Filtering`, plus nested iterator/matcher helpers. It mixes jar, folder, in-memory, compound aggregation, filtering, manifest handling, and element wrapper logic in one unit, which indicates low cohesion and insufficient modularization. The corresponding tests in `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/build/PluginEngineSource*.java` exercise these concerns separately, reinforcing that the class bundles several decomposable abstractions.
